notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.5.0 — One Work Item, start to finish

• A Work Item stays one Work Item until it's delivered. Write to one that stopped and it runs again with what you said; ask for a change while it waits for your review (or its pull request is open) and it's revised on the same branch; answer its question and it carries on. Only after its pull request is merged does new work become a linked follow-up. Tick "As a separate Work Item" by Send when you want one anyway. Run again runs the same Work Item, and History numbers each attempt.
• Investigate runs right in the error's panel: what it's doing, for how long, anything it needs you to allow, and its report — no other screen, nothing to send.
• Every link opens in your browser ("Open in Honeybadger" and the rest did nothing).
• A project's database extensions (pgvector, PostGIS, …) are installed when its VM is set up; if one is still missing, Vekrun installs it and carries on instead of spending the agent's repair attempts.
• The Work Item's actions are always shown again, and Back now steps between the Council, the build, the Interactive Browser and the preview.
• Codex installed as Homebrew's old formula (stuck at 0.42) is replaced with the current cask when you update it, and Sign in switches to Connect where Codex uses Vekrun's profile.
• The run tracker stays readable in a narrow window.
